highlights.description: Loader-enforced per-spec template/rubric provenance: a SpecSource declares which workflow owns a spec's template/rubric (or "local"), and a declared source that doesn't actually provide the file is a load-time error
Layered rubric schema (Class/Blocking/Evaluation, JudgeInstructions) extended onto structured-evaluation's RubricSet, wired through the library and regenerated JSON schemas

Hardened aws-one-way-door and aws-two-way-door workflows: normative enterprise contract templates/rubrics, symmetric optional deepening (MRD or OpportunitySpec both feed PRD synthesis in both doors), and a loader cycle guard covering both extends and explicit spec sources

prism-sync: a nested-module tool that copies roadmap-domain templates/rubrics from prism-roadmap with provenance headers and a -check drift mode, keeping prism-roadmap out of the library's module graph
Catalog registries for pipelines, loops, and integrations, with a cross-reference test validating pipelines against workflows/integrations/spec-types and loops against everything

added.description: Extend structured-evaluation's RubricSet with layered-evaluation fields; regenerate embedded JSON schemas from the Go types

Provenance-aware loader: SpecSource provenance, strict library-wide resolution guarantee (every declared spec resolves, optional included), and a cycle guard threading the resolution chain through both extends links and explicit spec sources

tools/prism-sync: manifest-driven copy of roadmap-domain content with provenance headers stamped from debug.ReadBuildInfo(), -check drift mode for CI, own go.mod so prism-roadmap never enters the library module graph

Harden enterprise-tree templates/rubrics into normative contracts: TRD as the normative technical contract, PRD template aligned to its rubric, TPD as a verification contract, IRD as a tool-agnostic infrastructure contract, UXD as the experience contract

Add hardened aws-one-way-door and aws-two-way-door profiles (door-named, keyed on decision reversibility, replacing the product/feature-named profiles) with full local template/rubric sets and symmetric optional deepening
Add continuous-discovery experience-map and opportunity-solution-tree (OST) content
Add v2mom family layered rubrics (vision, values, methods, obstacles, measures, alignment, summary)
Add embedded pipeline, loop, and integration registries with a cmd/catalog viewer and cross-reference validation

changed.description: Extend the strict library-wide resolution guarantee to optional specs across all profiles (0-1, big-tech families, pbhq-lite, startup, quick-fix)
Stop tracking the compiled tools/prism-sync/prism-sync binary (build artifact, not source)

documentation.description: Describe ecosystem roles in related projects (README)
Add the INIT-SPECWORKFLOWSPEC-001 spec set (PRD/TRD/PLAN/ROADMAP) and README sections on inheritance/provenance, layered rubrics, and domain-content sync

highlights.description: Canonical home for workflow definitions: all 24 default workflows (stage-based, methodology-based, big-tech syntheses, v2mom, pbhq-lite) are embedded and loadable as Go structs with no filesystem access
Breaking: pkg/profile renamed to pkg/workflow (Profile -> Workflow, inner Workflow field -> Execution); pkg/rubricdef removed in favor of structured-evaluation's rubric.RubricSet

added.description: Add embedded workflow registry and composable loaders (embedded, file, fs.FS, chain, resolving with extends inheritance and cycle detection)
Add default workflow definition library with 24 methodologies imported from visionspec
Add Content field to Template for filesystem-free template loading
Parse methodology YAML shorthand and grouped artifacts; add Artifact type and Methodology.Source

changed.description: Breaking: rename profile package to workflow; Profile is now Workflow and its phase ordering field is Execution

removed.description: Breaking: drop pkg/rubricdef and rubricdef.schema.json; rubric definitions use structured-evaluation's rubric.RubricSet directly

documentation.description: Document workflow packages, embedded library, and loader composition in README

highlights.description: Initial release of specification workflow spec library providing Go types and utilities for spec-driven product development workflows

added.description: Add spectype package with spec type registry (MRD, PRD, UXD, TRD, etc.)
Add synthesis package for spec generation dependency rules
Add profile package for workflow configuration with YAML parsing
Add template, rubricdef, and gate packages for spec workflow primitives
Add JSON Schema generation and schema files
Add diagram package for D2 and Mermaid workflow visualization
Add profile YAML parsing and profile utilities
Add layout package for filesystem layout conventions

Expand spec type tables and add diagram documentation
